Title: Scoreboard, build inspection and enemy habitat fixes
Changes: All player statistics now appear together in the scoreboard without a view dropdown.
Tab opens only the scoreboard. Escape takes priority when opening the pause menu.
Equipment icons stay stable while the character sheet refreshes, allowing hover descriptions to appear.
Weapon, tome and item descriptions show their current level, stacks and effects.
Cave sharks and Reef Leviathans are restricted to underwater maps, including boss, shrine and multiplayer spawn paths.
Classic Play continues to start in Thornmeadow.
